chain_words.nuance: to overstate facts, though not entirely untrue
to change facts so they no longer reflect reality
to say something known to be false
to mislead someone systematically for personal or political gain

explanation: These words all describe presenting untrue information, from mild exaggeration to deliberate and systematic deception.

usage_notes.difference: 'Lie' means saying something known to be false; 'deceive' means misleading someone, which may happen without any false statement.
